# DH-ADOM v1.0 Release Notes

DH-ADOM v1.0 defines the public reference model for hierarchical AI-native software engineering.

### Normative elements

- Engineering Constitution
- AI-SDLC integration
- ADLC integration
- Root Agent
- Feature Agent ownership
- Specialist Agent delegation
- Delegation Contract
- Agent Identity / Passport / Contract
- Bounded autonomy and delegation budgets
- Evidence and handoff
- Traceability and audit
- Cross-feature governance
- AI-resumable repository

### Non-normative elements

The reference implementation and benchmark scripts demonstrate the model but are not presented as a production orchestration platform.
